description: Add exercises and sets to a workout. Accepts gym shorthand ("lateral raise 5kg 4x12", "2min rowing machine") and creates the workout for that date if none exists.

allow_duplicates.description: Write blocks that already exist on that date with the same load and set count. Off by default — a repeated call is far more often a re-send than a second round.

sets_text.description: One movement per line. Understands "4x12", "40kg", "2dk"/"90sn", "3 set". Example: "lateral raise 5kg 4x12\nincline bench press machine 40kg 4x8"

type.description: Workout type. Sets go to the session of this type on that date; a new session is created when there is none.

workout_id.description: Add to this session. Needed when the date holds more than one session of the same type.

name: log_workout_sets
title: Log workout sets
